record.text:
Prevent concurrent resume workers for the same battery output (**highest priority**)

**Symptom.** While the override stage was still running, a second `--resume` invocation was able to start another override worker against the same output directory. `checks/after1/progress.log` contains repeated `RUN override` entries with different run IDs, and both processes wrote the same stage paths until one was stopped/completed.

**Risk.** Concurrent stage writers can corrupt receipts or make a later summary appear authoritative even though evidence came from competing workers. This is especially easy in environments whose foreground tool call times out while the child process remains alive.

**Suggested change.** In `scripts/run_generator_battery.sh` / the public check wrapper, acquire an atomic lock for `(task, phase, out, policy)` before spawning a stage. If the lock names a live PID with matching source/policy hashes, refuse the second run and print a copy-paste poll/status command. Only reconcile or replace a lock when the owner is confirmed dead. A `--wait-for-existing` option would be useful for automation.
